_doc: T4-CE slice 1: machine-checked field-watch registry — the single home for watch definitions.
Each entry: id, ticket (owner), description, type, patterns. The evaluator (watch_report.py)
runs every entry against a preflight corpus and emits one result line per watch.
type=watch results: FIRED(n) — the fired pattern matched n times (the check note says what
a session should confirm by eye); OPPORTUNITY-NO-FIRE(n) — the opportunity pattern matched
but the mechanism never fired (needs attention); NO-OPPORTUNITY — neither matched;
NOT-OBSERVED — no opportunity pattern is defined and the mechanism did not fire.
type=tally results: COUNT(n) — a metric, not a pass/fail.
summary=summary.txt. Patterns are Python regexes matched against the raw file text
Lifecycle: a watch whose firing has been confirmed by a session gets REMOVED here and its
closure recorded on the owning ticket — the registry holds OPEN watches only.

watches.description: first live system_resumed after a breaker episode

fired.pattern: "event"\s*:\s*"system_resumed"

watches.check: the resume must follow a breaker episode and cycles must continue after it

watches.description: first decisive gate acceptance on a gate-refusal loop

fired.pattern: T4-CC: originating .* passed on the staged candidate

watches.check: OPPORTUNITY-NO-FIRE is BENIGN when every gate-stamped leaf resolved 'Build fixed — BUILD_FIX subgoal no longer needed' (build-OK path; seen 07-17 run series + 07:18 run) — the decisive path's real opportunity is a green-probe REJECT on the gate-born fix, which the presence pattern cannot see

watches.description: dual smoke: the offline preserved-artifact reconstruction fired on a time-limit/kill run (a genuine rescue is smoke_preserved > smoke in summary.txt — read both fields by eye)

fired.pattern: preserved_source=(reconstructed|loop-preserved)

watches.description: verify-before-pause at the stagnation-runaway edge promotes done-but-unbanked work instead of halting

fired.pattern: T2-EO: verify-before-pause broke the stagnation runaway

watches.check: after the rescue line, the run continues (new merges or planning) instead of pausing; an honest stall (rescue found nothing) still halts stagnation-runaway

watches.description: first field firing of the freshness gate: an inherited preserved copy was ignored and the score came from THIS run's snapshots (the reconstruction half could not be validated retrospectively — run 3's snapshots were gone)

fired.pattern: preserved_source=.*-after-stale-loop-copy

watches.description: halt edge finds an unpackageable artifact and hands the repair to the loop instead of dying

fired.pattern: T2-EQ: the artifact does not package — repair work item injected at the

opportunity.pattern: T2-EQ: halt edge reached with an artifact the build tool cannot package

watches.check: the run must continue past the halt (more cycles after the line) and the repair item must not be re-created while it is open

watches.description: packaging repair item retired by the gate that raised it (unit-covered, never yet seen in the field)

fired.pattern: packaging now succeeds — marking (current|remaining) BUILD_FIX subgoal

opportunity.pattern: T2-EQ: halt edge reached with an artifact the build tool cannot package

watches.check: only the package gate may retire a package-gate item; a compile-OK cleanup must not

watches.description: a criterion contradicted by the running artifact AT THE CLOSURE EDGE by T4-CU's own verifier -- not by any other caller of the shared criterion probe

fired.pattern: was about to be closed on a claim the running artifact refutes

opportunity.pattern: closure claim not checked|closure claim not contradicted|was about to be closed on a claim|cannot check \S+ closure claim

watches.check: FIRED counts the verifier's own refusal line, one per refusal, so it is comparable across the archived corpus. NO-OPPORTUNITY means the verifier was never REACHED -- check T3-CC first: a closure whose criteria are all AUTHORED is filtered before the verifier is called, and a closure declaring none exits at DEBUG. Neither is the probe being weak. Cross-check a firing against closure_refused events with gate=T4-CU in the behaviour log, which are event-counted by construction.

watches.description: the criterion probe abstained because the packaged artifact declares no entry point -- counting BOTH outcomes: the refusal when the project owes one, and the silent-no-opinion when it does not (a library, or two candidates)

fired.pattern: T1-GD:

watches.check: FIRED counts the gate's OWN abstention lines, both forms. Tell them apart by the text: 'no status it observed would be the criterion's own' is the REFUSAL (the sources name a sole entry point, so the project owes one and the closure is blocked); 'the sources name no single one' is the DECLINATION (a library or two candidates -- the probe still abstains, but this gate demands nothing). Do NOT point this at the refutation prose ('declares no entry point') -- that text travels into the injected work item and re-matches on every echo, which is the defect t4cu-criterion-contradicted carried twice. OPPORTUNITY-NO-FIRE means the artifact was launchable and is the healthy case -- that reading is only trustworthy BECAUSE the declination logs too; before it did, a declining gate was indistinguishable from a healthy one. Cross-check: exit_status_probe_runs in summary.txt should be 0 for the sweeps where this fired.

watches.description: how many parseable criteria actually get a usable probe out of the local model

fired.pattern: (?:behavioural|exit-status) criteria probed=\d+ skipped=\d+

watches.check: skipped >> probed means synthesis or the drift guard is rejecting nearly everything — read the per-criterion INFO lines before tuning the parser

watches.why: T4-CY's suppression guard (same finding not re-raised while open) has NEVER been exercised: across 4 field runs the loop always repaired a finding before it recurred. The volatile-token normaliser that makes the guard possible is therefore only unit-proven.
watches.look_for: a log line 'T4-CY: same finding as last observation' — or, as the failure signal, two behavioural-defect goals with IDENTICAL descriptions in one run

watches.why: T3-BX's field half: the status-path facts reach the evolution prompt (6 renderings in one run, confirmed) but no run has yet had a model type GAIN constraints. T4-CU's probe is the verifier — it currently reports 'POST /books -> 400, but answered 201' with 0 constraint annotations on every model type.
watches.look_for: a model type gaining a constraint annotation AND the next observation reporting 400 instead of 201 for that endpoint

watches.why: KNOWN DEFECT, filed unfixed: requireEntryPointNow reads the cycle-start file map, so it re-raises the requirement one cycle after the loop satisfies it (observed in both runs; can reopen a just-closed goal). Bounded by idempotency.
watches.look_for: 'gap contradicts recorded completion — reopening' immediately after an entry point is written; confirms the churn is still present until the stale-view fix lands

watches.why: T4-DA's remaining DoD half: does a work item appear for a specification clause BECAUSE the readout named it? A goal claiming a named clause proves nothing on its own — the planner reads the seed too. The control is the three frozen runs of 2026-07-30 (df2a907, no readout), in which 11 of the 16 seed clauses are NEVER fully articulated by any run's plan. Those 11 are the discriminating set.
watches.look_for: EVALUATE WITH: python3 scripts/clause_coverage.py --against-control scripts/clause_control_df2a907.txt <run_dir>. The control file holds the 11 clauses no run of the df2a907 frozen series articulates; the per-run baseline is 0 of 11 (verified: all three controls score 0). DECISION RULE, stated in advance: 3 or more readout-enabled runs averaging >=1 closed clause supports the mechanism; averaging 0 refutes it and T4-DA's readout should be re-read as inert prompt weight rather than defended. First observation 2026-07-30_18-39-00 closed 1 ('title required, max 120 chars'), n=1, nothing concluded. JUDGE NET EFFECT, NOT CLAUSE CLOSURE ALONE — the cost side is measured and non-trivial: scripts/prompt_block_report.py puts the SPECIFICATION COVERAGE block at ~665 est tokens per call, 23% of the evolution prompt (2.3% of a run's total prompt tokens), and the first readout-enabled run's median cycle was 162s against 130/135/140s for the three controls (+16-25%, n=1, confounded by ordinary model variance). A run that closes 1 clause and loses 8 cycles is not obviously a gain. Record median cycle time alongside closed clauses for each of the three runs. CORRECTION 2026-07-30: the +16-25% cycle-time figure was attributed to this block and the token accounting refutes that — the block is 2.3% of a run's prompt tokens (evaluation is 72%), so it cannot explain a 20% slowdown; the run stalled in LLMClient timeout retries minutes later with the model alive at 85% GPU. Still record median cycle time, but read it as generation variance unless a token-accounting delta backs it.

watches.description: the placement fact is a readout, and a readout without an actuator is a pattern this project has been bitten by. The opportunity is the fact reaching the evolution prompt; the firing is a type actually being written to the package its peers agree on. Slice 1 deliberately does NOT move the class, so a run that reports the anomaly for its whole length and never relocates the type is the outcome that decides whether the mover has to be built.

fired.pattern: Deleted Files: \[[^\]\s]

opportunity.pattern: sits in [^\n]*, but \d+ of the \d+ types named by the peers

watches.check: confirm BY EYE that the deleted file is the type the anomaly named and that a file of the same name now sits under the majority package the fact quoted — a relocation necessarily deletes the old file, but not every deletion is a relocation. Then confirm the anomaly stops being reported in later cycles. Control: run 2026-08-23_02-12-34 has 52 'Deleted Files: []' and no non-empty one, so this pattern is silent on a run where nothing moved. If the fact fires for a whole run and no move follows, record it on T3-BZ — the readout alone is not an actuator, and the relocation decision (package declaration, every import, the component-scan root) then has to be taken explicitly.

watches.description: Member-level classpath discovery. OPPORTUNITY is the service being consulted at all — it now logs every abstention at INFO precisely so a null result can be told apart from never being reached, which run 2026-08-28_00-33-32 could not do. FIRED is a call actually retargeted to the type the classpath declares. Proven offline (5 errors -> 0 on the run's own source, byte-identical to what the loop reached ~20 cycles later); the firing path has never occurred in the field.

fired.pattern: CompileFixInjector: misplaced-member

watches.description: Repository interface for unresolvable declared dependencies. OPPORTUNITY is the classifier recognising the shape at all — before this ticket it classified UNKNOWN and the injector returned at its first gate, so the model guessed another version (26 coordinates, one re-proposed nine times running). FIRED is a declaration removed or re-pinned from what the repository actually publishes. Note the deliberate asymmetry: UNKNOWN abstains, so a run with no network shows opportunity and no fire, and that is correct rather than a miss.

fired.pattern: CompileFixInjector: unresolvable-dependency

watches.description: Fourth false completion's signature: a root closing on a ledger cleared largely by GIVEN_UP and SUBSUMED rather than by work. Counts closure lines that report subsumptions, so the share of dissolved-vs-completed subgoals is visible per run without re-reading the log. The 2026-08-28 audit showed arrival path (T1-DJ relabel) does NOT predict a bad artifact — both 23/23 runs came through it — so THIS is the signal to watch instead.

fired.pattern: closure ledger clear: \d+ subgoal\(s\) accounted for \(\d+ subsumed\)

watches.description: The open half of T4-DT's DoD: a closure where a CONTENT criterion -- a claim about the value the tool prints for the specification's own worked example -- is probed by execution rather than abstained on. The exit-status counter beside it lumps every shape together, so probed=8 could not previously answer whether a content claim was among them.

fired.pattern: T4-DT: value criteria probed=[1-9]

watches.check: Read the probed criterion by eye: it must be a claim about a PRINTED VALUE, and its verdict must match what the artifact actually prints when run by hand on the seed's worked example. A contradiction against a CORRECT artifact is walling and is the failure this watch exists to catch -- contradicted=0 beside probed>=1 is the healthy reading on a correct tree.

watches.description: The routing gap closed on 2026-09-11: uncovered seed obligations go to the execution probe BEFORE a model is asked to read the source for them. Fires when the running artifact refutes a root closure claim. The opportunity is the seed requirements being gathered at the closure edge at all, so NO-OPPORTUNITY means the root never reached closure -- not that the probe stayed silent.

fired.pattern: T4-DT: root closure REFUSED by the running artifact

opportunity.pattern: T4-DK: \d+ seed requirement\(s\) are covered by no banked criterion

watches.check: OPPORTUNITY-NO-FIRE is the EXPECTED reading against a correct artifact and is not a defect: distinguish it from a blind probe by the verifier's own line -- 'closure claim not contradicted -- N criterion(s) offered' means it spoke and passed, 'none of its N criterion(s) can be executed' means it abstained. On a fire, confirm the injected work item carries ORIGINATING_GATE_KEY=GATE_CRITERIA and a non-empty done-when, since an empty one would hold the item open for the run's life.

watches.description: The deferral T2-FI added: every criterion came back confirmed, but the prompt could not carry all the evidence, so the closure attempt defers instead of completing. This is the guard, not the goal -- with the budget sized as measured it should almost never fire.

fired.pattern: T2-FI: every criterion came back confirmed, but the prompt did

watches.check: A FIRING IS NOT GOOD NEWS HERE -- it means evidence was still cropped, so check the budget against the project's actual source size before assuming the guard did its job. Repeated firings on one closure are the walling shape the asymmetry was designed to avoid: confirm the run still reaches a terminal rather than deferring forever.

watches.description: How often any verification prompt failed to carry all the evidence. Expected 0 on every target the project has: their entire Java sources are 8.3k-15.8k characters against a 120000-character budget. A non-zero count means the budget needs re-measuring, not raising by taste.

fired.pattern: T2-FI: the verification prompt does not carry all the evidence

watches.description: REGRESSION watch. T1-FY's fix is an absence, so what is watchable is the defect coming back: an exercise pairing a well-formed fixture with a non-zero expected status. In run 2026-09-11_19-58-35 that refused a 19/19 artifact four times across 24 minutes. ANCHORED to a live gate decision: the bare string also appears in INHERITED work-item descriptions, which a later run reprints in its startup goal-stack dump -- that fired twice on run 3 from text run 2 had written, and it is not a regression.

fired.pattern: root closure blocked.*check <well_formed_file> . exit [1-9]

watches.check: ANY firing is a regression, not an observation to interpret -- the run's artifact does not matter, because exit 0 on a well-formed file is what the specification requires. Count CLOSURES, not log lines: the archived run shows 4 blocked closures against 188 matches of the bare string ([[feedback-count-events-not-log-lines]]).

watches.description: The obligations FILE replacing the derived split in the field. Fires when a run reads the written obligations; the state it reports (PRISTINE / EDITED) says whose split the run is being judged against. clitarget's file is EDITED, so a live run there also exercises the hand-edit path for the first time.

fired.pattern: T6-S: using the \d+ obligations written in

opportunity.pattern: T4-DK: \d+ seed requirement\(s\) are covered by no banked criterion|seed coverage

watches.check: Read the state in the line: EDITED means the run is judged against the operator's split, PRISTINE against the model's. A FALLING BACK line instead means the file did not belong to this seed -- check the seed hash before assuming the file is wrong.

watches.description: T4-DO's deterministic packaging repair reached once per cycle instead of only when something chooses to package. Its only per-cycle route was BehaviouralSelfCheck, which abstains whenever the last compile probe failed -- and a broken build is exactly the state an unrunnable archive lives in. Measured on run 2026-09-21_14-29-16: that route ran ONCE in 24 cycles (17 of 19 interval elapses abstained), and the repair was reached only by the halt-edge pre-halt check, 7 seconds before the run ended, having been correctly diagnosed 27 minutes earlier.

fired.pattern: T4-DO: the packaged artifact could not run

watches.check: THE CLAIM IS ABOUT TIMING, NOT OCCURRENCE -- this repair already fired before the change, so a FIRED count alone proves nothing. Read the firing TIMESTAMP against the run's first cycle: minutes in is the per-cycle path; seconds before the terminal is the halt-edge check doing what it always did. OPPORTUNITY-NO-FIRE IS NOT BY ITSELF A REGRESSION -- as first written this check said it was, and on run 2026-09-21_20-41-36 it reported OPPORTUNITY-NO-FIRE(112) while the repair was CORRECTLY abstaining: the sources declared no entry point at all (grep -rln 'static void main' over that artifact returns nothing), so there was nothing to declare and the abstention is the documented library carve-out. A correct decline and a real miss look identical under a count. To tell them apart, read the T4-DO abstention lines: 'the sources name no single one' means correct decline; 'carries no Main-Class' followed by no repair line means a real miss. Note also that the opportunity phrase travels into the injected work item and re-matches on every echo -- 61 of those 112 were echoed goal text.

watches.description: T2-FL promotes an ACTIVE leaf when the running artifact is observed to satisfy every criterion the leaf states. On run 2026-09-23_17-47-43 it promoted nothing, the root closed anyway via T4-DW retiring three boot-gate items, and the run could not say which of two things had happened -- the sweep declined on every leaf, or it never had a candidate -- because the refusal was reported with log.debug alone and the runs log at INFO (zero DEBUG lines in the whole run). The observed_leaf_promotion behaviour event is emitted once per sweep, including sweeps with no candidates, so the two readings are now distinguishable.

fired.pattern: "event" : "observed_leaf_promotion",[^}]*"promoted" : [1-9]

watches.check: A FIRED count is sweeps that promoted at least one leaf, NOT leaves promoted -- one sweep can promote several, so read the promoted field before quoting a number. Then confirm BY EYE that the promoted leaf's criteria were actually observed rather than merely unrefuted: the claim is that the artifact was seen to satisfy them, and an abstained observation still lets structural criteria through by design. OPPORTUNITY-NO-FIRE IS THE INTERESTING READING HERE, not a regression -- it means candidate leaves existed and the sweep declined every one, and the reasons field on the event names what it objected to. NO-OPPORTUNITY means no ACTIVE leaf stated a criterion, which on a run that closed its root cleanly is the ordinary case and says nothing about the mechanism. Control: the same registry entry over run 2026-09-23_17-47-43 reports NO-OPPORTUNITY (verified), because that run predates the event -- so on any run built before this change the watch is BLIND and its NO-OPPORTUNITY is not evidence of anything. Check the jar carries observed_leaf_promotion before reading it.

watches.description: T2-ET gives the boot gate a vote on closing the work items it raised. Those items usually declare no acceptance criteria, so the T4-CU closure check abstained and a model score closed them: September archive, 45 boot-gate items closed by score and 0 by the gate; of the 37 whose next observation could be classified, 9 were followed by the very defect they named, and the self-check does not re-raise a finding identical to its last one, so each was lost for the rest of the run.

fired.pattern: T2-ET: \S+ was about to be closed while the defect it was raised for is still observed

opportunity.pattern: T2-ET: \S+ (was about to be closed|— the defect it was raised for is no longer observed)|T2-ET: cannot re-observe

watches.check: FIRED means a closure was refused because the gate reproduced the item's own defect verbatim. Confirm by eye that the item was later closed or retired only AFTER the defect stopped being reported, and that the refusal did not repeat every cycle for long (each costs a package and a boot). OPPORTUNITY-NO-FIRE is the ordinary reading on a healthy run: every checked closure found its defect gone, which is what 27 of 37 archive closures showed. Also read the 'a different one is' lines: those are closures allowed because the NEXT defect replaced this one, and they should be followed by that defect being raised as its own item.

watches.description: How often the evolution prompt carried the inference-clash advice (and, with it, the bounds naming both types). Before 2026-09-24 the block showed only the error's first line and a return-type hint.
watches.check: A count of renders, not of distinct errors: one failure re-rendered on the next attempt counts again. To judge the DoD, count probe failures whose own build output carries 'inference variable' per file:line (the method in T2-FF's measurement), and compare with the 49 percent baseline on the same target.

fired.pattern: Hint: the branches of one method or expression produce different types

watches.description: How often the loop noted a GRIND: the same failure signature recurring across cycles, noted at its third occurrence and at every doubling after (GrindDetector). The user asked that a grind which seems to repeat itself forever always be noted; this puts it in every run's report.
watches.check: Any count above zero: read the grind_detected events' signatures in the behaviour log, and whether the prompt block that names them changed the next attempt.

fired.pattern: "grind_detected"

watches.description: The boot gate's 'the packaged artifact declares no entry point' item now carries its own claim (archive-entry-point) and is retired every cycle by the build config and the jar, beside T4-DO's repair. Stamped 'serves' before, it waited for a clean serving launch: on flightsim run 2026-09-24_17-47-47 the repair declared the entry point 21 s after the item was raised, the tree then stopped compiling, and the item stayed ACTIVE for the rest of the run while the planner was refused three prunes.

fired.pattern: T4-DW: the archive's entry point is now declared

opportunity.pattern: observed behavioural defect injected as work: the packaged artifact declares no entry point

watches.check: FIRED should follow a 'T4-DO: the packaged artifact could not run' line within about one cycle, and the retired item should not come back unless the defect does (a retirement clears the self-check's repeat suppression, so a genuine recurrence is raised again). OPPORTUNITY-NO-FIRE is NOT by itself a regression: the repair abstains when the sources name no single entry point, and then nothing is declared and nothing may be retired. Check with grep -rl 'static void main' over the artifact before calling it one.

watches.description: A line marked for the derived tests that no kept test answers refuses closure instead of going to a reading (field111: receiver-questions closed GOAL_FULFILLED 14/16 twice on that reading). The opportunity is a writing that left a marked requirement to a reading.

fired.pattern: T6-U: root closure REFUSED

opportunity.pattern: T6-U: \d+ claim\(s\) of \d+ requirement\(s\);.*no kept test answers the rest

watches.check: Read the requirement the line names. Expected only on receiver-questions' record-component requirement, in a writing whose spikes all miss that form; on a run whose code meets it, the terminal is then an honest halt, not GOAL_FULFILLED. A refusal on edit-hunks means its live writing came out worse than the offline three (17/17) -- read the writing summary's answered count.

watches.description: Claim tests that failed on every throwaway implementation, rewritten once from the runner's report and then kept (offline 2026-10-27: 38 kept over three writings, none wrong on the real implementation).

fired.pattern: T6-U: \d+ claim test\(s\) failed on every throwaway implementation; \d+ rewritten, \d+ of them then passed

watches.check: Read the line's counts; a writing reused from the cache prints no such line.
